# Environment variables

<!-- Generated by `go run ./tools/docgen`. Do not edit by hand: change the code and regenerate. -->

Container-level settings only. Everything else (indexers, Usenet servers, naming, VPN, notifications) is set in the app under Settings, not here. `PUID`, `PGID` and `TZ` are read by the container entrypoint, not by the app. Each `CUE_` variable also works under its name from before the rename, `MEDIARIUM_` (for example `MEDIARIUM_PAUSE_AUTOMATION`); the `CUE_` name wins when both are set.

| Variable | Default |
|---|---|
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | `` |
| `APP_PORT` | `8264` |
| `AUDIOBOOKS_DIR` | `/audiobooks` |
| `BUNDLED_FLARESOLVERR` | `` |
| `CONFIG_DIR` | `/config` |
| `CUE_IMAGE_VERSION` | `` |
| `CUE_PAUSE_AUTOMATION` | `` |
| `CUE_STREAMING_ONLY` | `1` |
| `CUE_SUPERVISED` | `` |
| `DOWNLOADS_DIR` | `/downloads` |
| `EBOOKS_DIR` | `/ebooks` |
| `FLARESOLVERR_URL` | `` |
| `MOVIES_DIR` | `/movies` |
| `MUSIC_DIR` | `/music` |
| `TRUSTED_PROXIES` | `private` |
| `TV_DIR` | `/tv` |
| `PUID` | `1000` |
| `PGID` | `1000` |
| `TZ` | `Etc/UTC` |
